conversations.prompt: What are the pros/cons of wired internet?
conversations.chosen_response:
Wired internet provides a reliable, consistent connection throughout your home.  Most wired connections are wired right into your home, so you can be confident the connection won’t go down unless there is a problem with your router, modem, or other hardware.  Additionally, most wired connections are wired throughout your home, meaning the connection is consistent throughout.  You can also daisy-chain additional devices to your router if you need more internet capability or more storage.

The cons are that wired connections are not mobile -- if you want to connect to the internet from multiple locations in your home, you’ll need to have a wired connection to each location you want to access the internet.  Additionally, if you live in an apartment or other shared building, you may need to buy a router, modem, etc. for each device you want to connect, or you may need to talk with your landlord to setup a router in your unit that can handle multiple devices.  And if you ever move and want to keep your internet service, you may need to buy a router and modem to connect to the internet in your new home.
